title: ai-rulez generation plan
description: Output of `ai-rulez generate --emit-plan FILE` and generator.PlanOutputs: every file a generate run would write, merge into or remove, computed without touching disk. Deterministic (paths sorted, no timestamp) and free of secrets: MCP placeholders stay as written and the content digest of a sensitive output is omitted.

schema.description: Version of this document. A new field is additive; a removed or re-typed one raises it.

renderer.description: The generator's render-schema version; a renderer change changes digests.

profile.description: The profile that was rendered (absent for a role run).

role.description: The role that was rendered (absent for a profile run).

path.description: Slash-separated, relative to the project root.

action.description: write: ai-rulez writes the file whole; merge: a document shared with the consumer, only the keys ai-rulez owns are written; mkdir: an empty directory.

mode.description: Permission bits in octal; absent for a directory.

size.description: Bytes of the rendered content, before the header's Generated stamp and hash lines.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the same bytes. Omitted for a sensitive output.

local_only.description: A machine-local output: gitignored, never committed.

sensitive.description: May carry a secret: git-ignored and written owner-only.

raw.description: A verbatim payload (skill resources) without a header.

removals.description: What a run takes back, sorted by path.

reason.description: stale: a file an earlier run recorded and this one no longer renders; unmerge: entries ai-rulez earlier merged into a shared document are taken out; delete: the document holds nothing user-authored once they are.
